{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|The cuisine of the Kubaz may not be for everyone, but I guarantee you'll want to finish your meal with a thick slice of this scrumptious royal jelly roll. The filling is a tasty blend of worker zingbees, arthropinians and pectin-flies, and it's all dusted with powdered sun beetle chitin.|Dex's Diner menu, on its Kubindian royal jelly roll|<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>}}
'''Arthropinians''' were creatures that were eaten by the [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Arthropinians, along with [[zingbee]]s and [[Pectin-fly|pectin-flies]], were used to make the filling of the [[Kubindian royal jelly roll]]  served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Arthropinians were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
